{"a":16,"b":313,"reason":"Rule 16 keeps the host's 'what happened next?' question to set up the next beat. The log's host-connector rule cuts 'then what?' questions by default and keeps them only to bridge pieces that don't join."},
{"a":7,"b":16,"reason":"Rule 7 cuts the host's clarifying questions and filler. Rule 16 keeps a host question that sets up the next beat, and that kind of question can look like a clarifying one."},

{"a":8,"b":312,"reason":"Rule 8 keeps a viewer comment when it is the objection that a guest or the host then answers. The log says viewer comments read on air are always cut."},
{"a":10,"b":349,"reason":"Rule 10 limits film damage to B-roll zoomed to full screen. The log puts film damage on all B-roll, including fit-to-frame and small-window B-roll."},
{"a":22,"b":340,"reason":"Rule 22 says the clock is fine on studio frames. The log says anything showing the TV clock is always blurred."},
{"a":7,"b":187,"reason":"Rule 7 cuts most jokes and filler. The film-episode rule selects by laughs, teasing and banter, and the host's jokes are the same kind of material."},
{"a":44,"b":131,"reason":"Rule 44 ends the 1-min on a held reaction face under the sting. HKS-15 says the 1-min should end on the punch or the shocking number."},
{"a":6,"b":50,"reason":"Rule 6 says to shorten as much as possible and drop asides. Rule 50 says every piece must be a whole thought and brings back the line before a joining word."},
{"a":7,"b":157,"reason":"Rule 7 cuts the host's name checks. The check in 157 keeps extra seconds where the host names a person so the name is set up before later use."},
{"a":43,"b":195,"reason":"Rule 43 says a cover needs a bigger zoom in the square. The reframe note says zoomed covers keep their scale at the same centre."}
